ai_summary: Udyam is the free online MSME registration giving enterprises a certificate and scheme benefits.
ai_explanation: Udyam Registration replaces Udyog Aadhaar. Enterprises self-declare with Aadhaar, PAN, GSTIN, and investment/turnover data to get a Udyam certificate, unlocking credit, subsidies, and tender benefits. It is free and instantaneous.
